targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' AND created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'LOGIN' AND datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'OK' AND created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT usuarios_idusuarios) FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'LOGIN' AND datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'OK' AND usuarios_idusuarios IS NOT NULL AND created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_ateventos_auditoria) AS "time", SUM(CASE WHEN tablaeventos_auditoria = 'auth' AND datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "LOGIN", SUM(CASE WHEN tablaeventos_auditoria = 'auth' AND datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "LOGIN_ERROR", SUM(CASE WHEN operacioneventos_auditoria = 'INSERT' AND tablaeventos_auditoria != 'auth' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "INSERT", SUM(CASE WHEN operacioneventos_auditoria = 'UPDATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "UPDATE", SUM(CASE WHEN operacioneventos_auditoria = 'DELETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DELETE" FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion', operacioneventos_auditoria::text) AS accion, COUNT(*) AS total FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT ea.created_ateventos_auditoria AS "Fecha", u.nombreusuarios AS "Usuario", COALESCE(ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion', ea.operacioneventos_auditoria::text) AS "Acción", ea.tablaeventos_auditoria AS "Entidad", ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' AS "Resultado", host(ea.ip_origeneventos_auditoria) AS "IP", ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'error' AS "Error" FROM eventos_auditoria ea LEFT JOIN usuarios u ON u.idusuarios = ea.usuarios_idusuarios WHERE ea.created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY ea.created_ateventos_auditoria DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT ea.created_ateventos_auditoria AS "Fecha", u.nombreusuarios AS "Usuario", COALESCE(ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion', ea.operacioneventos_auditoria::text) AS "Acción", ea.tablaeventos_auditoria AS "Entidad", ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'error' AS "Mensaje de error", host(ea.ip_origeneventos_auditoria) AS "IP" FROM eventos_auditoria ea LEFT JOIN usuarios u ON u.idusuarios = ea.usuarios_idusuarios WHERE ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' AND ea.created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY ea.created_ateventos_auditoria DESC LIMIT 50
